I cannot provide a T80 (operational-lifetime) prediction, because none of the tools I have access to model lifetime. My available models are CatBoost regressors for **PCE (%)** only (`predict`, `what_if`, `explain_local`, `explain_global`, `optimize`), trained on the Perovskite Database with architectures `overall`/`nip`/`pin`. There is no lifetime/T80 model, no lifetime training data, and no lifetime uncertainty interval available to me.

What I could not find or do:
- No tool returns T80, degradation rate, stability, or any time-to-80%-performance output.
- No lifetime features (encapsulation, contacts, illumination/humidity/temperature stress conditions, ageing protocol) are exposed by the tools, so I cannot state assumed values for them.
- I did not invent a T80 number or an uncertainty interval, since that would be fabricated data.

What would be needed: a separate lifetime model trained on stability/ageing data (with stress conditions and encapsulation metadata), or an external experimental T80 measurement.
